main_text.l: R E M P. [?] omnis de Rep. consilij fundamentum,
omnis in Repub. rectè administrandâ, pruden-
tiæ fons est & scaturigo uberrima. Quare im-
mortales gratias, ut Frisia omnis, sic nomina-
tim Groninga vestra & Omlandia
debent æternumque debebunt ingenio clarissimo
Historici sui inclyti Ubbonis Emmii, cu-
jus Spiritu Resp. vestra etiam post fata ejus su-
binde renascitur, nunquam intermoritura. Cui
Patriæ suæ [?] cum bonum civem quem-
vis favere & opitulari, quantum in se est,
conveniat, ego meo loco impensâ operâque ob-
stetricari studio curæque habui singulari. Qua-
re non tantum Syntagma illud præclarum, quod
Cl. Emmius de statu rerum deque jure Provin-
ciæ hujus felici stylo condiderat, cum distractis
exemplaribus passim illud expeti ab amantibus
patriæ cognovissem, recudendum suscepi, sed
simul operam dedi, ut cultius nitidiusque pro-
diret, tum aliis, quæ cuilibet perlustranti fa-
cile erit agnoscere, tum imprimis Geographicâ
tabulâ geminâ, quarum altera Urbis, altera
totius

page.notes: The Greek phrase after "Patriæ suæ" is only partly legible (the printed form seems to be a compound ending in -γενεσία, probably παλιγγενεσία, with a prefix); it is marked [?] and not transcribed with certainty. "REMP." in small capitals is uncertain ([?]). The text ends on "totius" at the right, which is the catchword, not part of the paragraph. The stray marks in the margins are not text. A "Digitized by Google" watermark at the bottom right is excluded.
